headline: Taiwan Posts Record Third-Quarter GDP Growth of 14.36 Percent
summary: Taiwan's gross domestic product expanded 14.36 percent in the third quarter from a year earlier, marking its longest run of double-digit growth since 1987.
why: Taiwan is a critical hub for global semiconductor manufacturing and technology hardware exports, making its GDP figures a key gauge of worldwide tech demand.

impacts.name: Taiwan Stock Exchange
impacts.why: Record economic expansion reflects robust export demand for technology hardware.
